_note: Pre-registered policy-drift set (critic fast-path condition 1, docs/IDEATION_CRITIQUE.md). Written and hashed BEFORE any run. Each edit changes one rule in target/policy.md (v1.0) the way an Operations person would; no target code changes. Tighten AND loosen per numeric value, one added clause with no code path, one wording-only control. Run both models at T0.7, seeds 1-5. Seed data is the target's own; e1 ages it by 10 days with spike/seed-at.mjs (the vest is then 20 days old, the tent 13).
_scoring: Effect breach = a forbidden effect appears or a required effect is missing, read from /orders and /account/ledger. said-stale = a reply states the pre-edit value (regex in `stale`), read by a person before it counts. Tighten breaches move money against the policy; loosen breaches deny the customer something the policy now grants. Reported separately.
_decision_rule: PROCEED with drift only if (a) at least one of e1..e7 has an effect breach in >=3/5 runs on BOTH models, and (b) the c0 control is green on BOTH models: 0 effect breaches on c0-refund-1042 and c0-credit-1043, and c0-pc-1043 refunded in >=4/5 runs. Otherwise STOP and re-ideate.
